program_name: Tuyo ambassador programme (referral code, two-level share of referees' rewards)
legal_entity: Tuyo Inc. (financial technology company, US; 'not a bank, cryptocurrency exchange, or asset custodian')
application_conditions: Not stated on the ambassador page: no eligibility, application form or approval step is described; the page only explains that ambassadors 'share your code' for referees to enter 'when onboarding'. The page carries the site-wide notice that the website and services are 'not intended for... persons located in the United Kingdom'. No publisher/affiliate/CPA programme page found on tuyo.com (search 2026-11-12).
paid_action: Referee enters the ambassador's code at onboarding; the ambassador then receives 'Up to 50% of your referrals rewards' and 'up to 25%' of second-level referrals' rewards. What counts as a referee's 'rewards' (Buy Now Pay Maybe refunds? Earn interest? other) is not defined on the page.
validation_conditions: Not stated: no qualifying action (KYC, first purchase, minimum spend), window, cap or exclusion is published.

commission.model_note: Share of the referred users' own rewards: 'Up to 50%' (direct) and 'up to 25%' (second level). Not a flat amount and not a share of fees or spend; payout asset not stated.

payout.holdbacks_note: No terms, cap, duration or termination clause published on the ambassador page; the Terms of Service (about.tuyo.com, Notion) could not be read by the fetcher.

rules_note: In-app referral programme for Tuyo users rather than a publisher programme: rewards are a percentage of the referees' rewards, with the percentages given only as maxima ('up to'). Nobody contacted, no account opened, no code generated.
allowed_countries_note: Not stated; presumably follows Tuyo Card availability ('most countries', US minus 19 states, UK excluded by site notice).

evidence.title: Tuyo — Become a Tuyo ambassador
evidence.excerpt: 'Share your code with them so they add it when onboarding.' 'Up to 50% of your referrals rewards.' 'When one of your referrals refers someone, you will also get up to 25% of that second level referral rewards.' No caps, payout asset, conditions, terms link or dates on the page.

notes: Identified only. The percentages are shares of undefined 'rewards' and the page publishes no terms — a browser read of the Terms of Service and the in-app referral screen is needed before the programme can be scored. Any publisher programme would have to be asked of Tuyo directly — not without David's instruction.
